blocks.text: Living in Crescent Beach & Ocean Park
Living in Crescent Beach Ocean Park, South Surrey

parts.t: Crescent Beach Ocean Park is the MLS® sub-area in the southwest corner of South Surrey; the MLS® lists it as “Crescent Bch Ocean Pk.” It joins two old seaside communities. Crescent Beach is a low village at the mouth of the Nicomekl River, below the Crescent Heights bluff. Ocean Park, on the east side of Boundary Bay, had grown from a summer resort into a settled community by the time its hall was built in 1925. By the water, coastal flood rules shape a home; on the bluffs, slope and drainage do.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations and school catchments before you buy or sell.

blocks.text: Planning in Crescent Beach Ocean Park

parts.t: Crescent Beach has its own land use plan, and the shoreline brings coastal flood rules.
The Crescent Beach Land Use Plan was approved in April 1999 (Corporate Report C421). A review began in 2016, and no land use changes were expected from it.
Surrey’s coastal floodplain covers about 20% of the city’s land, and Crescent Beach is one of the communities the Coastal Flood Adaptation Strategy plans for.
Ocean Park Community Hall is protected by a Heritage Revitalization Agreement bylaw (2011, No. 17402), and Crescent Park Annex is on the Canadian Register of Historic Places.

parts.t: Ask for the flood construction level.
In the village, find out the level a new floor would need before you budget a rebuild.
Ask about storm surge and overland flood cover before you remove subjects.
On the bluff, check retaining walls and drainage, and ask for any geotechnical reports.
The Crescent Beach Land Use Plan sets the type and density of development below the bluff.
Visit on a warm weekend if you can, and confirm what parking comes with the home.
Check the catchment and, for French Immersion, which school the program runs at.

blocks.text: Crescent Beach Ocean Park questions

parts.t: Is Crescent Beach in a flood zone?
Crescent Beach ground is 0 to 3 metres above sea level and sits inside a dyke system. The City’s Coastal Flood Adaptation Strategy covers it, so check the exact property.
Is there a plan for Crescent Beach?
was approved in April 1999 and aims to keep a semi-rural seaside village character, with shops along Beecher Street.
Where does the name Crescent Beach come from?
According to BC Geographical Names, landowners named it for the crescent shape of Mud Bay because they disliked the older name, Blackies Spit. The post office became Crescent Beach in 1951.

Can I bring my dog to Crescent Beach?
On-leash dogs were allowed on the walking path on weekdays during a City pilot, which is now complete, and staff are preparing a report for Council. Blackie Spit Park has two fenced off-leash areas.
Which schools serve Crescent Beach Ocean Park?
